mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) compresses risk-free rates, increasing the relative attractiveness of equities and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts below 950 (thousands) signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 950, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) and rising unemployment (UNRATE > 5.5%) signals a central bank response to a recession, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 AND UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In recession regimes (UNRATE > 5.5%), the S&P 500 tends to rebound within 20 trading days due to the expectation of central bank and fiscal policy responses to the economic downturn.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 139000) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS > 139000, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rises above 6.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days (approximately one quarter).
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 105) and housing starts (HOUST < 960) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105 AND HOUST < 960, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In weak labor market regimes (PAYEMS < 140000), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to reduced consumer spending and economic uncertainty, leading to negative 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when PAYEMS < 140000, or the Rank IC over the last 5 years is below 0.05.
